question: Across every calendar date in 2025, including dates with zero Delivered orders, what was the average number of Delivered orders for each weekday? Which weekday had the highest average?

action.query:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    d.DAY_NAME,
    d.DATE_DAY,
    COUNT(o.ORDER_ID) AS DELIVERED_ORDERS
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.DIM_DATE AS d
  LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER AS o
    ON o.ORDER_DATE = d.DATE_DAY
   AND o.IS_DELIVERED = TRUE
  WHERE d.DATE_DAY >= '2025-01-01' AND d.DATE_DAY < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY d.DAY_NAME, d.DATE_DAY
)
SELECT DAY_NAME, AVG(DELIVERED_ORDERS) AS AVG_DELIVERED_ORDERS_PER_CALENDAR_DATE
FROM daily
GROUP BY DAY_NAME
ORDER BY AVG_DELIVERED_ORDERS_PER_CALENDAR_DATE DESC

action.answer: Average Delivered orders per calendar date in 2025, including dates with zero Delivered orders: Monday 9,094.365385; Tuesday 9,082.788462; Wednesday 9,053.773585; Thursday 9,473.653846; Friday 12,228.980769; Saturday 14,486.211538; Sunday 13,119.134615. Saturday had the highest average, at 14,486.211538 Delivered orders per Saturday calendar date.
